entry.title: Salt Lake City is all about #Access ✨

media:group.media:title: Salt Lake City is all about #Access ✨
media:group.media:description:
Salt Lake City is all about #Access ✨
At this year's ADA Celebration, an Explorer walked the expo floor and connected with a professionally trained, Visual Interpreter to read the signage marking the day the ADA was signed into law and check out what was in each booth.
That same complimentary Visual Interpreting is available all over the city, downtown Salt Lake City, on TRAX, in municipal buildings, at the airport, and at the Delta Center, offering one more tool for access for the blind and low vision community.
Download Aira Explorer to browse hundreds of Access Partner locations where service available for free.
#AccessPartners #AccessForAll #BlindAndLowVision #AssistiveTechnology #InclusionMatters
